CA certified Turnover during last three financial years 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-2 5 (Required minimum Avg. turnover of Rs. 11.82 lakh). The Turnover should b e issued by practicing CA with Membership Number, seal and signed with UDIN In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 years old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of co nstitution shall be taken into account. In this case, the financial turnover during last financial year / the average financial turnover during preceding two financial years s hould be at least Rs. 11.82 lakh ii. Offers of Class-I and Class-II Local suppliers as per Make in India pol icy can only be considered for evaluation and award of contract. Security Deposit: The supplier receiving the LoA is required to furnish the required performance security, in the pres cribed form by the specified date; if the supplier / contractor fails to submit the performance securi ty as indicated above, Performance Security will be deducted from running bills. Supplier shall submit the security deposit for 05% of the order value (basic contract value without taxes) within 14 days of the P.O. date in the form of DD or bank guarantee as per R.C.F. format fro m R.C.F. approved banker valid for a period of delivery period plus 60 days for claim period. Or Per formance security may be furnished in the form of Insurance Surety Bond, account payee demand draft, fixed deposit receipt from a commercial bank, bank guarantee issued/confirmed from any of the commercial bank in India, or online payment in an acceptable form. If the supplier / contractor fails to submit the performance security as indicated above, Performance Security will be deducted from running bills The performance security will be forfeited and credited to the procuring entity’s account in the eve nt of a breach of contract by the contractor. It shall be refunded to the contractor without interest, after he duly performs and completes the contract in all respects but not later than 90(ninety) day s of completion of all such obligations including the warranty under the contract. Bank guarantee to be addressed and submitted to: Chief Manager Finance, RCF Thal Un it, Alibag, Raigad 402208.

Technical Conditions: 1 Quantity Required 6 MT Anionic Polyelectrolyte (HRSCC) Anionic Polyelectrolyte (used in HRSCC) 2 Polyacrylamide 90% Appearance - White crystalline powder Total solid 88% -90% (W/W) pH (0.1 % solution) - 7.0 to 8.0 Bulk Viscosity (0.1% solution) - 40 to 200 cPS If any deviation is found in the technical specifications mentioned herein, the material shall be li 3 able for rejection Terms & Conditions / Technical Requirements: 1. The Bidder/Supplier shall supply the material in a staggered manner. RCF shall intimate the Bidder/Supplier regarding the requirement and delivery schedule. 2. The Bidder/Supplier shall deliver the material within 7 days from the date of intimation b y e-mail from the concerned RCF Officer. First delivery shall consist of 03 MT of Anionic Polyelectrolyte (used in HRSCC) 3. The Bidder/Supplier shall be responsible for the proper performance and effectiveness o f the supplied chemical in the RO/ETP system. If required, the Bidder/Supplier may colle ct water/effluent samples from the ETP during the bidding period for testing and evaluat ion and shall quote accordingly, considering the characteristics of the effluent and the r equired treatment performance. 4. All materials shall be supplied on suitable wooden pallets to facilitate safe handling, sto rage and movement at RCF Thal. 5. The Bidder/Supplier shall provide a Test Certificate/Certificate of Analysis (CoA) issued b y a NABL-accredited laboratory along with each supply. 6. Material received at RCF Thal shall be inspected by RCF Thal. RCF representatives will dr aw samples and analysis will be carried out at RCF’s laboratory. The results obtained at RCF’s laboratory will be final and binding. The consignment shall be rejected if it does n ot meet the PO specification. 7. The Bidder/Supplier shall provide the applicable Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS) alon g with each supply. 8. The supplied chemical shall be used within the specified permissible consumption limits under normal operating conditions of the plant. The allowed chemical consumption shall be as follows: Allowed Consumpti Sr. No. Chemical Unit on Limit 1 Polymer for HRSCC Dosing Kg per day 15 In case a higher chemical dosage/consumption is required for satisfactory plant operation, the a dditional chemical consumption cost attributable to such excess consumption shall be recovere d/deducted from the Bidder/Supplier’s bill, as per the terms and conditions of the Purchase Orde r/Contract. 9. The Bidder/Supplier shall take back all empty plastic bags supplied by them after each su

bsequent delivery. 10. Payment shall be made on the 20th day from the date of acceptance of the material by R CF, subject to submission of all required documents and compliance with the applicable t erms and conditions of the Purchase Order. There will be deduction if late delivery will be found as after due date of intimation. 11. The material shall have a minimum shelf life of one (1) year from the date of receipt at R CF Thal. 12. Anionic Polyelectrolyte and Cationic Polyacrylamide is required for the operation and mai ntenance of the ETP Upgradation Plant installed at RCF Thal Unit. The ETP Upgradation Pl ant comprises Oil & Grease Trap, Flash Mixer, HRSCC, Centrifuge, Multi Grade Filter (MGF ), Ultrafiltration (UF) and Reverse Osmosis (RO) systems. 13. Tolerance: Overall quantity tolerance of ±25% shall be applicable to the total quantity of chemical covered under the Purchase Order. 14. Contract validity – 1 Year from the date from the date of Purchase Order. 15. The quantity of chemical mentioned in the tender/PO are approximate and indicative qua ntity only. RCF does not guarantee procurement of the entire quantity mentioned in the t ender/PO. Payment shall be made only for the actual quantity of chemical supplied and a ccepted at RCF Thal. No payment shall be made for the balance/un-supplied quantity. 16. The pH of the solution shall be measured as per IS 3025, and the viscosity shall be measu red on a Brookfield make viscometer. 17. Packing of Material: Material should be neatly packed in Drums / HDPE Bags and shal l be palletized for transportation and handling. Material should be properly wrapped/ packed on pallets so as to ensure that Drums /bags don’t fall from the pallets while u 6 nloading Please note material will not be unloaded and may lead to rejection if not palletized. 7 Tolerance +/- 25% Documents to be submitted along with offer: · PO copies as per above mentioned criteria · CA certified Turnover proofs of last three financial years as mentioned above mentioning UDIN · Make in India declaration as per Make In India Policy mentioning % of local conte nt and place of value addition · No deviation certificate as per format given in bid document Additional Information: 1.
